notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a noncreature spell on the stack.
description:
Cast Sudden Substitution by paying {2}{U}, exchanging control of your opponent's noncreature spell and Surrak.
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, targeting Surrak.
Surrak's last ability triggers, causing its controller to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, targeting Surrak.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
